title: Logspace uniformity implies polynomial-time uniformity
statement: Let $C$ be a family of directed acyclic Boolean circuits. If $C$ is logspace-uniform, then it is polynomial-time-uniform: a polynomial-time-computable function outputs the encoding of $C_n$ on the unary input of length $n$, for every $n$.
